description: This file defines a readonly struct `GenericGrainType` in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a parameterized grain type with functionality to parse, construct, and compare such types. It includes methods for handling generic arity, parsing grain types, and retrieving type arguments.

classes.name: GenericGrainType
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a generic grain type with associated methods for parsing, constructing, and evaluating equality.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainType into a GenericGrainType based on its generic arity.

methods.name: GetUnconstructedGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed version of the current GenericGrainType.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a new GenericGrainType with specified type arguments using a provided formatter.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments of the grain type using a provided converter.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain type.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another GenericGrainType instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the grain type.
